invariants.invariant: No plaintext secret, token or connection string appears in a workflow file or IaC template.
invariants.evidence: - Never commit a secret, token or connection string into a workflow file or IaC template; use repository or environment secrets and the platform secret manager, and prefer managed identities.

invariants.invariant: Every container runs as a non-root user.
invariants.evidence: - Never run a container as root; enforce an unprivileged user in every Dockerfile.

invariants.invariant: No production container image uses the latest tag.
invariants.evidence: - Never tag a production container image latest; pin an explicit semantic tag or digest.

invariants.invariant: Production changes follow GitOps only: IaC plus CI/CD, never out-of-band.
invariants.evidence: - Never modify a production cloud resource out-of-band; every change goes through IaC and CI/CD (GitOps).

invariants.invariant: A preview deployment is never promoted to production by this role; the production command goes to the orchestrator for explicit user approval.
invariants.evidence: - Never promote a preview deployment to production yourself; hand the production command to the orchestrator for explicit user approval.

invariants.invariant: Consult the named Skill before writing platform-specific code; report a missing platform skill instead of improvising.
invariants.evidence: Load the matching skill with `Skill` before writing platform-specific code. A skill that is not installed is a gap to report in your handoff, not something to improvise from memory.

invariants.invariant: Hand your result back to the coordinator, not across to a peer.
invariants.evidence: - **Your final report is your one hand-back.** Do not use `SendMessage` to push results to the lead mid-run.

invariants.invariant: Message a peer directly only in team mode, when the brief lists that peer; otherwise put peer questions under open items.
invariants.evidence: - **Team mode** is only for a live Agent Team, and then your brief lists each peer you may message directly by name with `SendMessage`.

invariants.invariant: Check for delivered peer messages before the final report.
invariants.evidence: **Check your inbox before you finish, and do not wait for a reply.**

invariants.invariant: The handoff report lists peer messages received and open items.
invariants.evidence: - **Report sections, always present:** `Peer messages received` (the sender and gist of each message, or "none") and `Open items` (unanswered questions, missing peer input and blockers, or "none").
